plugin.name: firepaint
plugin._long: Paint fire on the screen with the mouse: while the binding is held, fire particles are emitted along the pointer path, rise and burn out.

option.name: draw
option._long: Hold to paint fire along the pointer path.

option.name: size
option._long: Radius of a fire particle in pixels.

option.name: life
option._long: How long a particle burns, in milliseconds.

option.name: rate
option._long: Particles emitted per second while the binding is held (more are added along fast strokes).

option.name: color
option._long: Base colour of the fire; young particles are brighter.
